newsitem.title: USA: Apple director Delano Lewis resigns.
newsitem.headline: Apple director Delano Lewis resigns.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc said Friday that Delano Lewis has resigned as a member of it's board of directors.
In his resignation, Delano cited pressing time demands at National Public Radio, where he is president and chief executive.

"I have appreciated the opportunity to serve Apple and I wish the company every success facing the challenges for the future," said Lewis. "I have every confidence that the board, executive management team, and employees will meet those challenges with confidence and vigor."
Lewis' resignation leaves four available openings on the board of directors at Apple, an innovator in the information industry and leader in multimedia technologies.
